segments.text:
1 What the Church is.
2 How many waies it is taken.
3 What are the markes thereof.
4 Wherefore it is called holy and Catholique.
5 What is the difference betweene the Church & the common-weale, or ciuil state.
6 Whence it is, that the Church differeth from the reſt of mankinde.
7 Whether any may be ſaued out of the church.
